plan.notes: TERM-BY-TERM SEQUENCE: official Youngstown State University 2026-2027 catalog Four-Year Plan grid (CourseLeaf sc_plangrid). Credit ranges in the source use the LOWER bound (e.g. printed '120-123' -> 120.0). "X or Y" rows use the first-listed option as the plan code with alternatives in options. Prereqs not transcribed: the grid does not state them explicitly.
